home.heroSubtitle: Owners find chefs, waiters and baristas with work history they can trust. Workers see the salary, shift, weekly off, meals and stay before they apply.
home.point1Title: The terms are on the ticket
home.point1Text: No job goes live without salary, shift timing, weekly offs, meals, accommodation and deductions. What you read is what was promised.
home.point2Text: A job only becomes Verified history when the owner hires and the worker confirms joining. Everything else is labelled Self-reported.
home.point3Text: Workers' phone numbers are hidden until an owner shortlists them. No spam calls from every restaurant in town.
home.rolesLabel: Roles you can hire or find
home.trustTitle: Two years at one place, or three kitchens in six months? Now you can tell.
home.trustText: Each past job is marked by how we know about it. Workers can add the reason they left, because late salary and 14-hour days are part of the story too.
home.w1Text: Your role, cuisines, skills and the pay you want. No CV needed.
home.w2Text: Filter by city, salary, meals and accommodation. Every ticket shows the full deal.
home.w3Text: See when you're shortlisted, get interview details, and confirm joining to earn a Verified job.
home.o1Title: Post a job with clear terms
home.o1Text: Takes three minutes. Share it on WhatsApp groups with one tap.
home.o2Text: Read work history, reviews from past employers and the reasons people left.
home.o3Text: Mark hired with the agreed salary. Your team, reviews and history stay in one place.
home.ctaText: Post the job now. Workers nearby see the full terms and can apply from their phone in a minute.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: A job board built only for restaurants and cafés. Here is how it works for both sides, and how we keep it honest.
how.w1Text: Email or Google. Choose "Looking for work".
how.w2Text: Role, cuisines, skills, expected pay and shift. Add past jobs with the reason you left.
how.w3Title: Apply to jobs with clear terms
how.w3Text: Every job shows salary, shift, weekly offs, meals, stay and deductions.
how.w4Text: When an owner hires you, confirm you started. That job becomes Verified on your profile.
how.o1Text: Name, address and phone. Our team calls to verify you.
how.o2Text: The form won't publish without the full terms. Share the link on WhatsApp.
how.o3Text: See history, reviews and notes. Phone numbers unlock when you shortlist.
how.o4Text: Record the agreed salary and start date. Both sides review each other later.

level.unverified: Signed up, email not confirmed yet.
level.email_verified: The owner confirmed their email address.
level.business_verified: Our team called the business and checked the address.

how.selfReportedText: Added by the worker. Not checked by anyone yet.
how.verifiedText: The owner hired them here and the worker confirmed joining. Cannot be edited by the worker.
how.s1Text: The terms you applied for stay on the job page, so there is a record if anything changes.
how.s2Text: Workers' contact details are shown only to owners who shortlist them.
how.s3Text: Fake jobs, unpaid wages, harassment, false profiles or unfair reviews. Our team reads every report.
how.s4Text: Only confirmed placements can be reviewed, once per side, and the other side can reply.
how.s5Text: Nobody is banned on one complaint. We check first and both sides can respond.
how.neverPayTitle: Never pay to get a job
how.neverPayText: Workers never pay owners or agents to apply or join. If someone asks, report it.
how.q1A: Yes. Creating a profile, applying and tracking applications are free.
how.q2Q: Who can see my phone number?
how.q2A: Only an owner who has shortlisted you for a job you applied to, and our team.
how.q3Q: Why can't I edit a Verified job?
how.q3A: Because both sides confirmed it. That is what makes it worth trusting. You can add context with the reason for leaving.
how.q4Q: What if the terms were different after joining?
how.q4A: Report the job and leave a review once you are able to. Repeat problems lead to removal.
how.q5Q: Can owners find me without me applying?
how.q5A: Only if "I am looking for work" is on. They can invite you to apply, but still can't see your number.
how.q6A: All of India. Search by state and city.
how.contact: Something wrong? Use the Report link on any job, business, worker or review.
